name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: A toolkit that makes AI coding assistants remember things between sessions, follow safer habits, and work more efficiently across tools like Claude Code and Cursor.
buyer: A solo developer or small team relying daily on AI coding assistants who's frustrated their AI forgets context and repeats mistakes across sessions.
business_use_cases: An indie developer installs it so their AI coding agent remembers project conventions and past decisions across sessions instead of relearning each time.
A small dev team standardizes it across every engineer's AI assistant setup to enforce consistent, safer coding habits.
A consultant selling 'AI agent setup' services uses it as the backbone of a package they install for clients new to AI-assisted development.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid 'AI agent setup & tuning' service for teams who want this configured and customized for their specific codebase

steal_this: Offer a flat-fee 'get your AI coding agent set up properly' service: install and configure this plus a few other tools for a client's repo in an afternoon.
